action.prompt:
A source file was just saved. Verify it complies with the coding standards in `.kiro/steering/coding-standards.md`:
- Rust (.rs): rustfmt-compatible formatting, all public items have `///` doc comments, no `unwrap()` across the wasm boundary, errors use `thiserror`.
- TypeScript (.ts/.tsx): strict types (no `any`), all exported functions have JSDoc, wasm imports only via `src/wasm.ts`, no inline styles in JS.
- HTML/CSS: semantic HTML5, accessible controls with ARIA labels, CSS custom properties for colours/spacing, no inline styles in JS.
- All: no dead code, no magic numbers.
If you find a violation, flag it and suggest the fix.
